visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up of a young woman's face, specifically focusing on her right cheek which shows visible red spots and mild acne. She uses her fingers to point at her skin, looking directly into the camera with a neutral expression. The background is a plain white wall. (2) The scene transitions to the woman in a bright studio setting, decorated with white and blue balloons. She is wearing a black cat-ear headband with a pink skull. She holds a blue jar of La Roche-Posay cream, demonstrating its white, smooth texture by spreading it on the back of her hand and then dabbing small amounts onto her face. (3) A series of clips show the host at a professional brand event. Large blue wall panels display the years 2019, 2022, 2023, and 2025. She holds the product jar in front of a La Roche-Posay logo backdrop. A female doctor in a white coat is seen speaking into a microphone at the venue. (4) Graphic overlays appear on the screen, illustrating skin layers and scientific data about penetration depth (110μm). A group of four other women are shown sitting on a white bench, laughing and reacting to the presentation in a minimalist, well-lit hall. (5) Back in the studio, the host holds a small blue serum bottle with a dropper. She applies the clear liquid to her forehead and hand, showing its consistency. A split-screen comparison follows, displaying a close-up of skin texture labeled 'Before' and 'After'. (6) The host holds up promotional items: a circular phone grip featuring the Disney character Belle and a pink folding umbrella decorated with castle and crown motifs. The video concludes with a high-quality product display of the serum and cream together against a white background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a clear female narration over a silent background. The tone is sympathetic and inquiring. (2) A rhythmic, upbeat synth-pop BGM fades in as the narrator's volume increases, shifting to a more promotional and energetic delivery. (3) Subtle 'whoosh' sounds mark visual transitions between the studio and event footage. Faint background room noise and the distant voice of a doctor can be heard during event clips, though the primary narrator remains the focus. (4) Gentle 'pop' sound effects are used to highlight the appearance of on-screen graphics. The BGM remains steady with a consistent electronic beat. (5) In the final phase, the narrator's excitement peaks when mentioning the Disney collaboration, followed by a crisp audio fade-out as the video ends.
